summary: The Dimension tool places dimensions on the canvas. One pick previews its own dimension at the pointer, drawn thin with the measured value: a line its length, an arc its radius and a circle its diameter. A second pick re-evaluates it: two parallel lines take the distance between them, other line pairs an angle, a point and a line a point to line distance, and two points their distance, where the pointer to the left or right of both points gives a vertical distance, above or below both a horizontal one, and elsewhere an aligned one. Pointer moves render the preview alone: no graph row, placed dimension or canvas root renders, and no solve or analysis runs. A click on empty space or Enter places a driving dimension at the measured value through the existing sketch preparation, cancellation and input-version checks, as one edit and one undo step. Dimension then stays active with nothing picked, and the placed dimension becomes the selection, so Enter or a double-click opens its editor. When preparation finds that the driving dimension over-defines the sketch, the tool places its reference form instead and says so; with no reference form it refuses in the solver's own words and keeps the picks. A relation the dimension implies, such as Parallel with a line-pair distance, is dropped when preparation finds it redundant. Right-click during the preview opens a shared menu with Place as reference, the other dimension types and the relations that fit the picks, listing what does not apply disabled with its reason. Dimension starts from the toolbar or D, from selected geometry or plane references, and from the geometry menu, and it takes a point to the origin or an axis, an arc or circle center to an axis and a line to an axis it runs along in either order. Escape drops the picks, then returns to Select through the shared Escape rule; during a placement it stops the edit and keeps the picks. A placement whose document, version, sketch or tool session changed applies nothing.
warning: Potentially breaking for people and automation that drive the sketch canvas: the Dimension tool no longer opens the relations editor. Picking the geometry and confirming now places a driving dimension at the measured value at once, so nothing moves and no editor opens; Enter or a double-click on the placed dimension opens its editor. Automation that waited for the dimension editor after picking, typed a value and pressed Apply should place the dimension, then open its editor with Enter and set the value there. A dimension that would over-define the sketch is placed as a reference where the editor used to report the conflict. The Horizontal distance, Vertical distance and Aligned distance choices for two points follow the pointer position, or the right-click menu, instead of an editor choice; a circle places a diameter and an arc a radius, with the other form in the menu. Escape with picks drops them and keeps Dimension active; Escape with nothing picked returns to Select, also when Dimension was started from Line, which it used to return to. When the sketch changes while picks wait, the picks and their selection are dropped and Dimension stays active. Where a dimension is drawn is not saved; placed dimensions take their usual layout. WebMCP tools, their arguments and results, the CAD schema and saved documents are unchanged. No breaking change for installed posts, machine packages, saved revisions or controller output.

checklist.schema: No CAD schema change: placements save through the existing set-sketch-relation edit with the existing distance, axis-distance, point-line-distance, parallel, line-angle, radius, diameter, fixed-axis, horizontal, vertical and reference-dimension kinds. The label position the pointer chooses is not persisted; that needs a schema change in a later update. No UPID, post, machine package, execution plan, saved revision, storage, journal, worker reply or native buffer protocol change; the Rust solver and committed WebAssembly module are unchanged. Post engine API remains 1 and saved-job engine remains 3.
checklist.events: No execution event change. Placement uses the existing cancellable command submission with the document, version, sketch and Dimension session ownership checks; a stale or cancelled placement applies nothing, and the reference fallback retries only after a CadSketchPreparationError, which leaves no history, so the attempt that applies is the only undo step. Picks that wait are a pending workflow, so agent mutations return WORKFLOW_OPEN until they are placed or dropped. WebMCP tools and their arguments are unchanged.
checklist.capabilities: No post or machine capability change. Dimension places dimensions from the canvas; the dock dimension editor stays for editing placed dimensions, and the relations panel keeps its commands.
checklist.auditAndOutput: No generation, audit, numbering, encoding, line ending, feed or controller-file change.
checklist.installationAndStorage: No installed package, revision, browser-cache or folder storage change. Saved documents open unchanged, and the Dimension tool state is not persisted.
checklist.verification: cadSketchDimensionPlacement.test.ts checks the pointer regions for point pairs, the plan for each pick kind with its values, ordering and blocked reasons, datum operands including a line to an axis in either order, the pick rules after each pick, linked edges pairing without a size of their own, preselection order, the preview layout and the redundant-implied and reference fallback rules. CadSketchCanvasRender.test.tsx checks that pointer moves with a preview showing render the preview alone, with no graph row, placed dimension, canvas root or picker query, and that the type follows the pointer region. CadWorkbench.test.tsx checks each entry path (toolbar, D, preselection, geometry menu and datum picks), placement as one undo step with the tool idle and the dimension selected, Enter opening its editor, the reference fallback and its status, the refusal with the native reason keeping the picks, the dropped implied Parallel, the stale-document guard, Escape during a placement, the right-click menu with its disabled reasons and a relation leaving the tool idle, and a line measured from an axis. e2e/cad-sketch-dimension-placement.spec.ts places a line length, a parallel distance, an angle, point-pair distances by pointer position, a datum distance, a reference fallback and a right-click relation, then undoes them in Chromium. The existing dimension specs were updated for the place-then-edit flow. The full Vitest suite, build, lint, UI check and release check pass.

publicNotes.summary: Dimension places dimensions on the canvas with a live preview.
changes: Pick a line, arc, circle, point pair, line pair, or geometry with the origin or an axis; the dimension follows the pointer with its measured value.
For two points, the pointer to the left or right gives a vertical distance, above or below a horizontal distance, and elsewhere an aligned distance.
Click empty space or press Enter to place a driving dimension at the measured value. Dimension stays active, and Enter or a double-click on the new dimension opens its editor.
Right-click during the preview for Place as reference, the other dimension types and the relations that fit the picks.
A dimension that would over-define the sketch is placed as a reference, and the status line says so.
Escape drops the picks; with nothing picked it returns to Select.
publicNotes.compatibility: No file, schema or tool change. Installed machine packages, posts, saved revisions and controller output are unchanged.
publicNotes.action: Dimension no longer opens the relations editor: pick the geometry, place the dimension, then press Enter or double-click it to type its value. Where a dimension is drawn is not saved yet.
